principles.text: Sell results, not software: when anyone can vibe-code your app, the outcome you deliver is the product.
Keep the cost of acquiring a user below ARPU, and push yearly plans so paid acquisition stays cash-flow positive.
Skip a two-tier free/pro structure: add features to higher tiers so customers upgrade and LTV keeps growing.
Concentrate a launch into GitHub's trending window: hold PRs, avoid weekends and pull traffic from Reddit, DEV, LinkedIn and X.
Growth compounds: invest in one branded product instead of starting new SaaS that each begin at zero authority.

sampleQA.question: How do I get distribution for my SaaS in 2026?

answer.text: Sell the result, not the software. Postiz moved from "a tool that schedules posts" to selling money, views and customers.
Publish many more X articles, run "comment X to get Y" lead magnets and UGC on every platform.
Reach buyers where they already gather, not your followers. For Postiz that meant n8n users.
